title: Design System: Olivia Koeppen, Instructional Design Portfolio

display.purpose: Name on the home sign and case-study titles.

label.purpose: Directory labels, dates, nav, figure labels.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Arrow nudge on project rows and the primary button. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single action in a case-study sign aside.
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; font-family: Overpass, Arial, sans-serif; font-weight:700; padding:.8rem 1.25rem .7rem; background:#8a1c32; color:#fff; border:2px solid #8a1c32; text-decoration:none; border-radius:0; } .ds-btn:hover { background:#6a1426; border-color:#6a1426; }

components.name: Directory Row
components.description: Label column plus value, used for facts and contact.
components.css: .ds-dir { border-top:2px solid #17151a; margin:0; } .ds-dir div { display:grid; grid-template-columns:7.5rem 1fr; gap:1rem; padding:.7rem 0; border-bottom:1px solid #d9d5dc; } .ds-dir dt { font-family: Overpass, Arial, sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:.9rem; } .ds-dir dd { margin:0; font-family:'Source Serif 4', Georgia, serif; }

narrative.overview: The site behaves like a university signage system: one garnet sign at the top of every page, then quiet, orderly directories on a white ground. It reads like careful course material, not a creative portfolio.
keyCharacteristics: One garnet sign panel per page
Directory rows with a label column
Overpass for wayfinding, Source Serif 4 for reading

rules.name: The One Sign Rule
rules.body: A page has exactly one garnet field, at the top. Garnet elsewhere appears only as ink.

dos: Do render text artifacts as real HTML and offer the original file as a download.
Do give outcome numbers garnet Overpass 800 with a plain label.
donts: Don't add cards, shadows, rounded corners, gradients, or eyebrow labels.
Don't use muted tints or Boise State / CWI colors.
